summary: Focused re-test of the P0 'Refresh Daily Usage' fix. (1) Ran the standalone logic test /app/backend/tests/test_dailyusage_backfill.py -> ALL PASSED (all 5 cases: old campaign resumed today counted=40 with 7 failed refunded, pre-window sends excluded, all-failed campaign 3000->0, update_last_activity does not slide the window anchor, expired 24h window resets to 0). (2) Created /app/backend/tests/test_refresh_daily_usage.py (pytest, 10 tests) covering both new endpoints + RBAC + auth/me regression + a 2-recipient campaign -> 10/10 passed. (3) Admin UI flow on the public URL: login as qaadmin, header 'Refresh Daily Usage' button clickable -> toast 'Refreshed 17 user(s), 0 corrected', POST /api/users/refresh-daily-usage 200; 'Used Today' column renders 17 cells (e.g. '0 / 250'); per-row refresh icon -> toast 'Daily usage refreshed', POST /api/users/{id}/refresh-daily-usage 200. No console errors, no layout breakage.

issues: 'Used Today' column is hidden below md breakpoint (hidden md:table-cell) so mobile admins cannot see or use the per-row refresh icon - acceptable but worth confirming it is intentional
Used Today value uses light slate text (0 / 250 with the limit part in a lighter grey) - borderline contrast on white, consider darkening the limit portion
Per-row refresh icon has no visible tooltip/aria-label, so its purpose is not discoverable

critical_code_review_comments: routes/users.py refresh_all_daily_usage caps users at .to_list(1000) and recalculates sequentially with one aggregation per user; fine at 17 users but will time out / silently skip users if the base grows past 1000 - consider pagination or a bulk aggregation.

recalculate_daily_usage pre-filters campaigns on updatedAt/completedAt/createdAt >= window_start (ISO string comparison). This is correct only while all three fields are stored as ISO-8601 UTC strings; a campaign whose recipients were sent in-window but whose updatedAt was never bumped would be missed. The send loop does bump updatedAt today, so no bug observed - just a coupling to note.
Endpoint route order (POST /refresh-daily-usage before GET /{user_id}) is correct; keep new literal routes above the /{user_id} catch-all.
seed_data_creation: Transient: 5 throwaway users + campaigns created and deleted by test_dailyusage_backfill.py; one 2-recipient campaign 'TEST_usage_*' created via /api/messages/send on qatest and deleted afterwards (sentCount=0, failedCount=2 as expected with dummy BizChat creds).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Campaign creation is POST /api/messages/send (payload key is campaignName, not name) - there is NO POST /api/campaigns (returns 405). With dummy BizChat creds sends fail so dailyUsage is never incremented (update_last_activity is only called with sent_count of successful sends) - usage 0 -> 0 after refresh is the expected behaviour, not a bug. Reusable pytest: /app/backend/tests/test_refresh_daily_usage.py. Sonner toasts auto-dismiss in ~4s; poll for toast text instead of a single long wait.
rca_of_the_issue: Original P0: dailyUsage recalc filtered on campaign.createdAt >= lastResetDateTime, so campaigns created on earlier days that sent messages today were ignored. Fix verified: recalculate_daily_usage now aggregates per-recipient sentAt inside the 24h window and update_last_activity only seeds lastResetDateTime when missing. Both behaviours confirmed by the standalone test and the API-level tests.
